prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='FT_catboost', seasonality_champion='CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: FT_catboost emerges as the overall champion with the lowest RMSE (66.17) and perfect trend correlation (1.0), while CWT_rf leads in seasonality capture (0.47 correlation). The extremely high RMSE spread ratio (30.96) and significant model disagreement indicate that simple averaging would underperform. STL-hierarchical stacking is recommended to exploit the additive decomposition structure and leverage different models' strengths in trend vs. seasonality components.
